menu.subtitle: Defend Vancouver Island from the monster-pirates!
diff.easy.desc: EASY: -20% prices, -20% enemy HP, normal enemy speed, +25% gold
diff.normal.desc: NORMAL: standard prices, enemies and gold
diff.hard.desc: HARD: +25% prices, +30% enemy HP, faster enemies, -15% gold
ach.title: PIRATE ACHIEVEMENTS
res.title: RESOLUTION
sm.help.title: HOW TO PLAY
sm.help.l1: Build towers from the right panel, then click
sm.help.l2: on the map to place them.
sm.help.l4: Don't let them reach your base!
sm.help.c2: S  Sell tower      |  Q  Tower ability
sm.help.c3: T  Target priority |  R  Show all ranges
sm.help.c5: M  Music on/off   |  C  Filter towers by type
sm.help.c7: Ctrl+Z  Undo last build or upgrade
sm.help.t1: Same-type towers next to each other link up - each type gains a unique bonus.
sm.help.t2: Gold elites give 5x gold. Watch for rain: +15% gold!
hud.paused_sub: you can build and upgrade towers
boss.name: BOSS
help.l1: Build towers on grass to stop enemies.
help.l2: Enemies follow the dirt path to your base.
help.l3: Earn gold for kills, spend it in the SHOP.
help.l4: SPACE - pause | 1-5 - select tower | Q - ability
help.l5: M - music on/off | F11 - fullscreen | ESC - menu
help.l6: Click a tower to upgrade or sell it.
help.l7: Golden enemies give 5x gold - prioritize them!

upg.tesla.name: Tesla Coil
upg.tesla.desc: Zaps the nearest enemy every few seconds. Attracts storms; huge range in storms.
upg.facility.name: Drone Launch Facility
upg.facility.desc: Launches a combat drone: minigun strafes enemies, then kamikazes with a huge splash. Rearms in 3 min.
upg.cavalry.name: Call the Cavalry
upg.cavalry.desc: An allied ship cripples the pirate ship, then bombards enemies.

upg.medic.desc: Bombardment destroys towers half as often (50% -> 25%).
upg.signal.name: Signal Fire
upg.signal.desc: Campfire grows 2x. All Fire towers shoot 12% faster. Dancers guard the building with bows.

upg.spikes.name: Spike Barricade
upg.spikes.desc: Spikes on the road wound passing enemies.
upg.balloon.name: Recon Balloon
upg.balloon.desc: Scout balloon drifts overhead, dropping bombs on enemies.
upg.sabotage.name: Sabotage
upg.sabotage.desc: Saboteurs poison enemy supplies. All enemies spawn with -15% HP.
